en: "I see. So you threw it away...{w}Threw it awaaay, threw it away... Costo threw it away...{w}Heh... Heh heh heh... Ahahahahaha!!"{w}
note: Ragnastia snaps: stretched 'threw' (sute-u-ta) kept as 'awaaay'; laughter escalates as in the source.

en: "Um, Lady Ragnastia...{w}Are you, by any chance... angry?"{w}
"Of COURSE I aaaaam!!!!{w}Why did you go and throw it away!?{w}That's awful! That's just too cruel!!"{w}
Ragnastia crumpled to the floor.{w}
"Hahaha, you're overreacting.{w}What's the harm? We'll just buy a new one! All right?"{w}
"It's no good... It's just no goooood...{w}It has to be that blanket...{w}The Emperor Bird one... the cute one..."{w}{p}"Uuu...{w}Sniff...{w}Waaaaaaaah!"{w}
"Y-you're crying over this!? All right, all right, I get it!"{w}{p}"What was it... an Impala Boss? I'll have a blanket custom-made with embroidery that looks like it. That'll do, won't it?"{w}
note: Costo garbles 'Emperor Bird' into inpara bancho (impala + delinquent gang boss). Rendered 'Impala Boss' to keep the wrong-name joke (rank word swapped like Emperor -> Boss). New term, not in glossary.

en: "You don't get it!{w}Costo, you still don't understand what things are wooorth!!"{w}
note: yappari = 'still / just as I thought': echoes the Queen's earlier order that Costo learn the value of money.

en: "No, no, no! If anyone doesn't, Lady Ragnastia, it's you..."{w}
note: Ragnastia-sama koso... is cut off; rendered as Costo turning the charge back on her, left trailing.

en: "You're fired! Fired all over again!!"{w}
note: koutetsu = dismissal from a post; sai-koutetsu = dismissed again (he had just been reinstated).

en: Costo got the axe!{w}
note: Pun: kubi wo haneta is the Wizardry-style decapitation battle message, and kubi also means being fired. 'Got the axe' keeps both senses.

en: "Whaaat!?"{w}{p}"B-but I only got back the day before yesterday...{w}Look, I've just finished moving all my things in, and I was finally about to get back to my official duties..."{w}
"Starting tomorrow, you go back to the Kernel Shop and train some more!"{w}
note: shugyou = training/apprenticeship; his shop posting is framed as a lesson.

en: "No way, that's absurd!?"{w}
"Now listen to me, Costo.{w}This is not my anger as the Queen. This is my own, personal anger!!"{w}
"Um, so in other words, that's abuse of power..."{w}
note: Interrupted by the next row; left unfinished.

en: "Shut uuuuup!! Idiot Costoooooo!!{w}Don't you come back until you get it baaaack!!"{w}
note: baka Kosuto = 'Idiot Costo' per glossary title.

en: "What are you, a child!? Are you a CHILD!?"{w}
note: anta: rude address, said after she has stormed off.

en: "Sigh...{w}Honestly, I just can't make sense of the world anymore..."{w}{p}"I doubt it's anywhere anymore, but... if you find it dumped somewhere, would you find it and bring it to Lady Ragnastia for me?"{w}
note: sekai ga mien yo (lit. 'I can't see the world'): despair, rendered as losing all sense of things. Page 2 is identical to SCDWMAP:3055 (slice 010); keep both renderings the same.

en: "And who are you?{w}...A customer, you say? I don't know your face."{w}
"I see, so you're the new adventurer Miria mentioned. I am Costo. See that you remember it."{w}
note: Miria-kun rendered plain 'Miria' as in slice 008.

en: "By the way, if you're a rookie, I've got just the thing, you know?{w}Here it is: the Flamberge!!"{w}{p}"Word is it's a seriously awesome weapon! Just for you, I'll sell it for 500,000 GP.{w}Buy to your heart's content!"{w}
note: 'seriously awesome' matches SCDWMAP:2736 (same iketeru line).

en: "...Hm? What's that puzzled look for?{w}Expensive? It's only 500,000 GP, you know?"{w}
note: da zo? = incredulous: to Costo 500,000 GP is small change (cf. 2744), so 'only' made explicit.

en: "Hahaha, you pauper! In that case... half price, 250,000 GP will do.{w}Buy it."{w}
"What, you still won't buy it? Then how much WILL you pay!!"{w}
By chance, you spot a document left lying carelessly on the counter: something called the Bistel Commerce Guild Price Agreement.{w}{p}Under the entry for the Flamberge, it says 15,000 GP...{w}
note: Commerce Guild Price Agreement per glossary; 'Bistel' prefixed as in the source.

en: "Well, fine. If you insist I sell it at this price, I suppose I'll make a special exception and sell it to you...{w}Otherwise Miria will nag me again, after all."{w}
"What, my selection is poor?{w}Ah, it is a bit thin, yes.{w}...So, what do you want me to do about it?"{w}
"...???{w}Ah, don't tell me you lot...!"{w}
"If you're expecting me to go and fill out my stock, you're sorely mistaken!?{w}Who'd bother with something that tedious!? Bwahaha!!"{w}

"Who do you think I am? The Director of the Bistel Administration Bureau -- in other words, a minister! ...Well, for certain reasons I'm running an item shop, but still."{w}{p}"So I am under no obligation to stock arms and armor for your sake, and I have no intention whatsoever of building up my stock through trade either! Not one biiit!"{w}
note: kyokuchou = Director (parallel to Magic Bureau Director); daijin = minister. naaai stretched -> 'Not one biiit!' (added tag carries the drawn-out negation).

en: "Bwahahahaha! Are you suitably awed!?"{w}

"...Well, I do feel a little like stocking all sorts of things for you, but it's dangerous out there right now."{w}{p}"For wound salves and such -- the things the people's lives depend on -- I've worked things out with all the relevant parties so supplies stay secured...{w}Anything beyond that isn't at zero, but there's not much of it."{w}
note: kizugusuri = generic 'wound salves', not an item name here.

en: "Well, you adventurers take care of everything yourselves, don't you? Works out nicely, then. Bwahahaha!!"{w}
"...But, you know, I must say..."{w}
Costo leafed through the price agreement.{w}
"You people have been living with prices like these?{w}By my standards, it's unthinkable...{w}Hmmm... Well, well..."{w}
"...Pfft. Commoners."{w}

"Munch munch... Look at all this bread!{w}Your prices were so amusing that I took a walk around... munch... the castle town."{w}{p}"And then, munch... I found a shop selling bread this delicious for ridiculously cheap!!{w}I couldn't help buying... munch... a whole lot."{w}
note: Source typo soshita na for soshitara; translated as intended.

en: "I can't eat it all. I got a little carried away...{w}What am I supposed to do... munch...{w}It's tasty... no, it's truly delicious, but..."{w}{p}"...Can't be helped, munch... I'll go hand it out to some brats around here.{w}What's with that face? Don't tell me you want some?"{w}
note: gaki = 'brats', kept rough.

en: "You fool! You lot... munch... can earn your own money, so take your wallets and go buy it yourselves.{w}The place is... there, across from the tavern."{w}

"Say.{w}Have you lot ever been to Saimar?{w}You know, that place swarming with merchants."{w}{p}"Would you go there and get me a booklet called 'The Saimar Merchant's Companion'?"{w}{p}"The thing is, you people... and by that I mean ordinary folk, not adventurers..."{w}{p}"I've gotten curious how your economy actually works.{w}I want to use Saimar's methods as a reference."{w}
note: New item name: Saimar shounin no tomo -> 'The Saimar Merchant's Companion' (handbook title; recurs as a [Key Item] in slices 023-024). omae-tachi on page 3 = commoners in general, as Costo clarifies.

en: "...A reward?{w}Greedy, aren't you. Well, I'll think about it. I'm counting on you."{w}
"What, still struggling with it?{w}Hurry up and bring it! You're not some second-rate bureau clerk..."{w}
note: niryuu kyokuin ja arumaishi = 'it's not as if you were a second-rate bureau staffer'; left trailing like the source.

en: "Oh, you got it! Well done!!"{w}
"With this, I should have a good clue to how you people live."{w}{p}"Oh yes, your reward, wasn't it? I gave it a lot of thought, and I believe this is best.{w}Don't be shy, take it."{w}
"...My one-million-GP smile~"{w}
note: Music note -> '~' per convention.

en: "No, wait! That was only half a joke!{w}I'll think of something properly, I'll think about it, okay!?"{w}
note: 'only half a joke' keeps the source's unintended admission that half of it was serious.

en: "Anyway, I'll be taking this for now.{w}...Thank you."{w}
"Well? Have you gotten to where you can manage a slightly more decent adventure?"{w}{p}"Not that I can't pretty much tell how you're doing just by watching the stock here fill out!"{w}
"Wait, Sigret!"{w}
"I don't know what this Gate of the Underworld is or isn't, but disturbing the peaceful sleep of the dead like that! I can't allow it!!"{w}{p}"I'm going...!!"{w}
note: ikasete moraimasu = firm 'I will be going', against Saines's order to wait.

en: Shaking off Saines's words, Sigret ran out of the temple.{w}{p}Whatever she'd heard must have been serious.{w}She didn't even seem to notice you at the entrance.{w}
note: Sigret is female per glossary. yohodo no hanashi datta no darou ka rendered as narration's guess.

en: "I should not have told her after all..."{w}{p}"There is a bizarre thing called the Gate of the Underworld...{w}It is said that when its door is opened, a great many spirits appear.{w}Most likely they are magical creatures born of some evil will."{w}{p}"A rumor reached us that a ritual to open the Gate of the Underworld is being performed beneath the Madrie Church Cemetery."{w}{p}"I heard it from an adventurer myself, but Sigret pressed me for the details.{w}And I thought I knew what that child is like..."{w}
note: ano ko = 'that child' (Saines raised her, cf. 3249).

en: "I am sorry to ask such a thing of you, but would you bring Sigret back?"{w}{p}"Sigret should have gone beneath the Madrie Church Cemetery."{w}{p}"I believe you can still catch up. Please, I ask for your help."{w}
"Sigret!"{w}
"Bishop Saines..."{w}
note: Saines-sama from Sigret rendered 'Bishop Saines' throughout this scene (his title per glossary); 'Master'/'Lord' would misread.

en: "Welcome back, Sigret.{w}I'm so glad you made it back safely."{w}
"I saw something terrible.{w}Can that truly be the judgment of the gods...?"{w}
note: kami no gohandan: kami is unmarked for number; 'the gods' chosen for a polytheistic setting.

en: "...You saw inside the Gate of the Underworld?"{w}

"The Gate of the Underworld wasn't what I'd thought -- something that calls the souls of the departed back to this world."{w}{p}"It was a prison of souls, holding the souls of the in-between captive...{w}The Wraith and the old lord who were trying to open the Gate of the Underworld were trying to save the souls inside it."{w}{p}"And all I did was watch..."{w}
note: rouku (old lord) = Branet per glossary; not named in the source, so left as 'the old lord'. Wraith = the named wraith (glossary).

en: "...Simply not looking away from that reality is admirable enough."{w}
"Bishop Saines, do you know of something called Apasha?"{w}
"No, I can't say I've ever heard of it."{w}
"The Wraith and the others said that if I truly want to save those souls, I should go after Apasha..."{w}
note: reisu-tachi ga ... to: read as the Wraith's group speaking to Sigret (Saines's reply warns against listening to evil spirits). Who 'wants to save souls' is not stated; 'I' (Sigret) inferred. Alt. reading: '...if the Wraiths truly want to save souls, they should pursue Apasha'.

en: "Sigret. Lending an ear to the words of evil spirits is not a good thing, you know."{w}
note: jarei = evil spirit, as in glossary 'ancient evil spirit'.

en: "I know that!{w}But it didn't seem like they were trying to deceive me..."{w}{p}"That Wraith, too, doesn't seem to be just some king of evil spirits..."{w}
"Hmmm..."{w}
"Bishop Saines. I can't forget what lies on the other side of that door."{w}
"May I go out into the world as an adventurer?"{w}
"That I can't just leave things as they are... that there might be something I can do... That's how I've been feeling."{w}
"You never were one for being kept waiting."{w}
"...Why, even at breakfast, if I'm the least bit late, you skip the prayer and, my word, go right ahead and gobble it up..."{w}
note: asage = morning meal; mah = Saines's mock-scandalised aside; teasing, confirmed as a joke two rows later.

en: "Th-that was... B-Bishop Saines!?"{w}
note: Sigret flustered at being teased.

en: "Heh heh. I'm only joking.{w}Leave the temple to me, and go.{w}Follow your heart, and the wish to 'save them'."{w}
note: sukuitai in single quotes for the source's corner brackets; object 'them' (the souls) added for English.

en: "Bishop Saines, I will never forget the kindness you showed in taking me in when I had no one to turn to."{w}
"This is your home too.{w}Whenever you grow weary of your travels, come back anytime."{w}
"Thank you... Bishop Saines..."{w}
{0E}  * Sigret registered at the Training Hall *  {0F}{w}
note: System banner; full-width asterisks -> '*', padding kept as in earlier banners.

en: "Oh yes, that reminds me. This was delivered here for you."{w}
note: Addressed to Sigret; the next rows (slice 012) show the gift is thanks to her, so 'for you' is supported.
